body.title: git_objects: object, index and ref writes
body.summary: Add git_objects with commit-tree, mktree, mktag, write-tree, read-tree, update-index, replace, notes, fast-import, unpack-objects, index-pack and pack-objects, with the destructive classes the LLD lists (read-tree --reset, notes remove and prune, replace delete) as input-dependent functions tested for both branches, and the stdin ops. Mark the rows covered with cases and approval cases; only this Task's own rows are checked.
acceptanceChecks: Each op has a coverage case that checks the object, ref or index it changes
Each destructive input asks for approval and is denied with no client before git starts, and the safe input is common
A stdin delivery that fails is a failure with nothing reported as applied
